definitions.short: an oak or other strong tree
definitions.full: H436. elon I. אֵלוֺן noun [feminine] terebinth (= אֵלָה ) — ׳א construct Gen 12:6 4 t.; plural construct אֵלוֺנֵי 13:18 3 t. — terebinth (or other tall tree, compare below on 1Sam 10:3 ; Judg 4:5 ), marking shrine, & hence used in topographic designations; ׳א מוֺרֶה ( teacher's terebinth ) Gen 12:6 (see Di) so Deut 11:30 ; ׳א מְעוֺנְנִים ( eonjurors' tereb. ) Judg 9:37 ; distinguished by owner or ruler ׳א מַמְרֵא Gen 13:18 ; 14:13 ; 18:1 ; by neighbouring town (ב)צענים Judg 4:11 ; compare ׳א בְּצַעֲנַנִּים Josh 19:33 (editions אַלּוֺן , but see Norzi Baer Di.); ׳אֵ בִּשְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר מֻצָּב Judg 9:6 (compare אֵלָה Gen 35:4 ); ׳א תָּבוֺר 1Sam 10:3 read ׳א דְּבוֺרָה (& compare בָּכוּת אַלּוֺן Gen 35:8 , & דְּבוֺרָה תֹּמֶר Judg 4:5 ) compare Ew Geschichte iii. 31 Th Di Gen 35:8 (see also below אַלּוֺן ).
